description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Config_File_Compiler class for compiling Smarty config files. It includes methods for initializing compilation, parsing config source code, and handling errors. It references lexer and parser classes, as well as Smarty internal components.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Config_File_Compiler
classes.description: Main class responsible for compiling Smarty configuration files, handling lexing, parsing, and generating compiled code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the compiler with lexer and parser class names, and the Smarty instance.

methods.name: compileTemplate
methods.description: Compiles a given Smarty internal template, performing lexing, parsing, and code generation.

methods.name: trigger_config_file_error
methods.description: Handles syntax errors during config file compilation by throwing an exception with detailed message.
